type Counter = { value: number; read(this: { value: number }): number };
const counter: Counter = { value: 3, read() { return this.value; } };
const detached = counter.read as Counter['read'];
detached!();
function read(value?: Counter): number {
  return value?.read!();
}
type ExtraReceiver = (this: { value: number; extra: string }) => number;
(counter.read as ExtraReceiver)();
class Base {
  read(this: Base & { extra: number }) { return this.extra; }
}
class Derived extends Base {
  extra = 4;
  readBase() { return (super.read as typeof this.read)(); }
}
